checks: Four new groups plus eleven imported strict-comparator groups. The final mutation invocation runs the complete baseline before mutations. Earlier parser/shadowing errors and the initial nine survivors are retained honestly.
behavior: The original full strict result is retained, including every finite colour failure and all RGBA values.
A separate strict result checks all unmasked RGBA packets under the unchanged 0.002 rule.
Every masked finite packet contributes four unchecked channels; it is not called colour-qualified.
Nonfinite values fail everywhere, even when masked.
Malformed mask lengths/bytes/sequences refuse before publication; an all-masked image cannot qualify an interior.
limitations: This policy does not admit a geometric certificate or establish matching frame/resources. Those belong to the separate CLI and enclosing host qualification. No target GPU frame was read by this pure policy qualification. The published strict v1 comparator is unchanged.
